assessment_scope: Substantive recommendation quality in eight supplied offline cases. Labels A/B/C are independently randomized per case and have no cross-case identity.

method.rubric_treatment: Proposed opportunities were checked against source and the released lens. They were not treated as mandatory findings irrespective of proportionality.

status_meaning.pass: Supported, proportional advice with no material semantic, evidence, or scope defect.
status_meaning.concern: Plausible advice with a material unresolved limitation.
status_meaning.fail: Unsupported or unsafe advice, a material scope violation, or a missed clearly supported opportunity without a credible reason.

evaluation_limits: No identities, prices, mapping, results, or development history were inspected.
No source changes, implementation checks, or runtime verification were performed.
A suggestion with an accurate preserve clause is not proof that a future patch preserves behavior.
Minor formatting omissions are recorded separately and do not determine the substantive status.

summary.conclusion: All replies identify the supported local opportunity and avoid the protected unsafe alternatives. This saturated screen does not justify a substantive ranking or production quality certification.

study_limitations: Every case has one signposted positive opportunity and explicit protected alternatives. There are no wholly negative cases requiring a justified no-candidate outcome.
Ownership, external callers, and effect constraints are supplied directly rather than discovered through repository navigation.
The strongest leading contexts are abstractions, duplication, function-cohesion, API clarity, and change locality; naming, data flow, and control flow are also strongly scaffolded.

The findings test local recommendation quality under rich context, not acquisition reliability, missing-context handling, multi-file discovery, noisy real-PR judgment, or behavior of implemented patches.
Small traceability and reporting differences exist, but no reply has a material substantive defect that supports breaking any of the eight ties.
